verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at getaleph.com (HTTP 200) with an Aleph product summary, and several items quote structured capability lines from it, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Its content looks like a product overview rather than deep technical docs, and the markdown-page probe (.md) returned 404. missing for 10: deeper agent-oriented docs beyond the overview-level llms.txt, markdown versions of doc pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
